subject: Integration: SDK Starter Kit & Local routing smoke tests
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2028 07:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Integration: SDK Starter Kit & Local routing smoke tests

Alex — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of call:
- Brightpath wants a small on-prem/hosted evaluation: proof that Redwood can handle structured output + tool-calling flows and a semantic search pipeline (embeddings + reranker) with low-latency routing between region and fallback models.
- Priority sample apps: 1) Chatbot with tool calling (Python) 2) Search + reranker demo (TypeScript)
- Security note: you mentioned SSO + KMS for key management and evidence for SOC2 controls.

Technical acceptance criteria we heard:
- Local dev experience that runs against a Redwood sandbox (Python and TS)
- Auth modes: API key and OIDC SSO test harness (support for KMS/HSM later)
- Routing: prefer us-west region, fallback to lower-cost variant when capacity constrained; config should be demonstrable in the SDK
- Embeddings: ~500k vector index initially, 512-d vectors (we'll validate exact dims)
- Reranker: provide a small labeled set and a runnable reranker example

Deliverables I propose we ship to you by Jan 16: 
1) Starter repo (Python + TypeScript) with local-run instructions and smoke tests (dev container + Docker Compose). See attached starter-checklist.pdf for items.
2) Auth & routing quick-reference (how to wire API key vs OIDC, routing policy examples).
3) Embeddings sample and small reranker notebook + instructions for local test indexing.
4) 60–90 minute technical workshop (remote) to walk through the repo and run the smoke tests together — target Jan 18.

Owners / next steps:
- Rafael (me): coordinate delivery and run the technical workshop.
- Marissa: build the sample apps (Python chat + TS search).
- Karthik: auth/routing config and smoke-test harness.
- Neha: embeddings pipeline and reranker notebook.

Can you confirm the acceptance criteria above and whether Jan 18 for a workshop looks good? If you need any changes to the scope we can adjust the deliverables.

Thanks,
Rafael

From: Alex Chen <alex@brightpath.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumina.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2028 10:46:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Integration: SDK Starter Kit & Local routing smoke tests

Rafael — thanks for the clear recap. Confirmed on most points, a few clarifications: 

1) Auth: we use Okta (OIDC) for SSO and want to validate KMS integration for key rotation later. For the sandbox, an OIDC test flow + API key fallback is perfect.
2) Embeddings: initial seed is closer to 300k documents (500k vectors was conservative), vector dim will be 384 for our current model. We'll provide a small sample export (~5k rows) ahead of the workshop.
3) Latency SLO: sub-200ms p95 for embedding lookup + rerank on our test hardware — we know you may need to tune batching; would like to see the batching knobs in the sample.
4) Reranker: we have a small labeled set. A simple pointwise/learning-to-rank example in TS would be ideal.

Workshop: Jan 18 works for us, please send an invite. Also can you include a quick security questionnaire (we'll attach our baseline) — our security team will likely review before the workshop. I've attached the security_requirements.xlsx for context.

App owners on our side: Jordan Lee (engineering) will be the point person on the integration.

Appreciate the fast follow-up.

—Alex
Alex Chen
CTO, Brightpath AI
alex@brightpath.ai

Looping in the implementation owners. Proposed split and timeline below — Rafael please confirm owners on your side (Alex/Jordan) so we can set expectations: 

Work split (internal):
- Marissa: implement Python chat sample with tool-calling and structured output tests (Docker + local devcontainer). Deliverable: /examples/python-chat by 2028-01-13 EOD.
- Karthik: add routing policy examples in SDK config (region preference, model-fallback, batching knobs). Deliverable: routing.md + sample config by 2028-01-14.
- Neha: embeddings pipeline and reranker notebook (TS example + small labeled set). Deliverable: embeddings/ and reranker/notebook.ipynb by 2028-01-16.
- Rafael: coordinate packaging into the starter repo and schedule the Jan 18 workshop (send calendar).

Smoke tests we will include:
- Local start script that spins up a minimal Redwood sandbox proxy and a small in-memory vector store for reranker tests.
- Auth toggle: env var to switch API_KEY vs OIDC simulated flow.
- Routing verification: automated test that asserts preferred-region routing and fallback behavior when the preferred variant returns 429.

I'll add these to the starter repo README (link to be created). Rafael — attaching the dev-repo-readme.md stub; once the repo goes live I'll update the link in the thread.

Marissa
